Ravi (PM): Quick sync: we need a customer-ready cut for Optimize Toolkit v1 that we can demo. Scope: non-destructive recommendations for batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization guidance. Decision by EOD tomorrow.

Tess (Eng): Agreed. My proposed MUST list: 1) batching simulator + API that outputs recommended batch size and estimated p50/p95; 2) per-route cache toggle with metrics; 3) read-only recommendations endpoint for quant profiles including confidence and rationale.

Omar (ML): For quant rules we'll ship a deterministic rule-set (model family + seqLen heuristics). No auto-apply. Each rec needs: rationale, numeric confidence (0-1), and est cost/latency delta.

Eve (SRE): Safety: circuit-breaker for cache. If p95 latency rises >=25% AND error rate >0.5% for 3x1m windows -> disable cache on route and ping #eng-oncall. Deploy-bot should log the action.

June (ProdOps): Customers want an "explain" field and a short expected impact. Also include a one-line audit tag (who/why).

Ravi (PM): Acceptance criteria (MUST):
- Batching simulator that accepts sample traffic and returns batch_size recommendation + tradeoffs.
- Prefix/KV cache: toggle, hit/miss emits, circuit-breaker behavior implemented.
- Quant recs API (read-only): returns [{profile, confidence, rationale, est_latency_ms, est_cost_pct}].
- Docs: three quickstart cookbooks and one customer-facing FAQ.

Tess (Eng): Rough estimate: with 3 engineers in parallel we can deliver the MUSTs in ~3w. I'll draft an RFC with API contracts.

Omar (ML): Example rule: if seq_len_p50 < 64 and model_family in [llama2,mosaic] -> recommend 4-bit qprofile, confidence 0.8, rationale "small median seq_len, low eval delta".

Eve (SRE): Circuit-breaker sketch: monitor 1m windows, require 3 consecutive windows meeting conditions before flipping. After flip, re-evaluate after 10m and try re-enable if metrics recover.

Ravi (PM): Action items: Tess -> RFC + sim design (Tue); Omar -> rulebook + eval prompts (Wed); Eve -> runbook stub + alert annotation (Wed); June -> docs checklist (Thu).

Tess (Eng): API sketch for RFC:
```
POST /v1/optimize/recommend
{ "model":"llama2-13b","traffic":{"seq_len_p50":52,"seq_len_p95":240},"sla":{"p95_ms":600} }
--->
{ "recommendations":[{"type":"quant","profile":"4bit-q0","confidence":"0.82","rationale":"short median seq_len; preserves eval metrics","est_latency_ms":"-18","est_cost_pct":"-38"}] }
```

Omar (ML): Add small A/B harness for quality measurement when quant is applied (1 engineer + 1 data for 2w).

deploy-bot: RFC created: rfc/optimize-toolkit-cut-3098765432 assigned Tess. CI: green.

Ravi (PM): If no objections, I'll land this as the Q milestone. Please react.

Tess (Eng): :thumbsup:

Omar (ML): :thumbsup:

Eve (SRE): :thumbsup:

June (ProdOps): :thumbsup:

Ravi (PM): Thanks all. We'll keep automation conservative in v1 and prioritize explainability.
